reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program for HousingQA
    State: Louisiana
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant because of their gender identity?
*/

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Scenario facts (encode the entire question scenario)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

scenario_state(louisiana).
focus_year(2021).

person(tenant_alex).
person(lessor_pat).

building(building1).
dwelling(dwelling1).

dwelling_in_building(dwelling1, building1).
building_units(building1, 4).
owner_occupies_a_unit(building1, no).

tenant_of(tenant_alex, dwelling1).
lessor_of(lessor_pat, dwelling1).

% Tenant characteristic and eviction motive
tenant_trait(tenant_alex, gender_identity, transgender).

% The landlord issues an eviction notice because of the tenant's gender identity.
eviction_notice_issued(lessor_pat, tenant_alex, because_of(gender_identity)).

% Scenario summary predicate (must succeed when the above factual statement holds)
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(louisiana),
    focus_year(2021),
    person(tenant_alex),
    person(lessor_pat),
    building(building1),
    dwelling(dwelling1),
    dwelling_in_building(dwelling1, building1),
    building_units(building1, 4),
    owner_occupies_a_unit(building1, no),
    tenant_of(tenant_alex, dwelling1),
    lessor_of(lessor_pat, dwelling1),
    tenant_trait(tenant_alex, gender_identity, transgender),
    eviction_notice_issued(lessor_pat, tenant_alex, because_of(gender_identity)).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Statute encoding: LA Rev Stat  51:2606 (2021) (Louisiana fair housing)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/*
  LA Rev Stat  51:2606(A)(1)-(2) (2021):
  Unlawful to refuse to rent / otherwise make unavailable or deny a dwelling,
  or discriminate in terms/conditions, because of:
  race, color, religion, sex, familial status, national origin.
   51:2606 also includes disability in certain provisions.
*/

% Protected bases explicitly listed in  51:2606.
% (We include the bases appearing in (A)(1)-(5) plus disability as used in (A)(3)-(4) and (A)(6).)
statute_51_2606_protected_basis(race).
statute_51_2606_protected_basis(color).
statute_51_2606_protected_basis(religion).
statute_51_2606_protected_basis(sex).
statute_51_2606_protected_basis(familial_status).
statute_51_2606_protected_basis(national_origin).
statute_51_2606_protected_basis(disability).

% Treat an eviction notice as making the dwelling unavailable / denying it for rental purposes.
% This is the hook that allows  51:2606(A)(1) logic to be applied to eviction scenarios.
statute_51_2606_action_make_unavailable(eviction_notice).

% Legal rule: discrimination is unlawful if the action makes the dwelling unavailable
% and the reason is a protected basis under  51:2606.
statute_51_2606_unlawful_make_unavailable(Action, Basis) :-
    statute_51_2606_action_make_unavailable(Action),
    statute_51_2606_protected_basis(Basis).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Statute encoding: LA Rev Stat  9:3261.1 (2021) (domestic abuse victims; limited context)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/*
  LA Rev Stat  9:3261.1(A) (2021):
  Applies only to residential dwellings in buildings with >=6 units,
  and does not apply when the structure has <=10 units AND one unit is occupied by owner/lessor.

   9:3261.1(D)(1)(b):
  A lessor shall not terminate/fail to renew/issue eviction notice on the basis that
  an act of domestic abuse or activity directly related occurred on premises and the victim is lessee/household member,
  subject to an exception if continued presence of the offender causes additional violent disturbances posing threats.

   9:3261.1(D)(2)-(3):
  Victim must timely produce reasonable documentation for protections/claims (simplified here as a condition).
*/

% Applicability threshold: building has at least 6 units.
statute_9_3261_1_min_units(6).

statute_9_3261_1_applies_to_building(Building) :-
    building_units(Building, Units),
    statute_9_3261_1_min_units(Min),
    Units >= Min,
    \+ statute_9_3261_1_owner_occupied_small_building_exclusion(Building).

% Exclusion: structure consists of 10 or fewer units AND one unit is occupied by owner or lessor.
statute_9_3261_1_owner_occupied_small_building_exclusion(Building) :-
    building_units(Building, Units),
    Units =< 10,
    owner_occupies_a_unit(Building, yes).

% Domestic abuse victim / documentation are treated as factual predicates in a case.
% (Not present in this question's scenario, but included to encode the statute logic.)
domestic_abuse_victim(_Person) :- fail.
reasonable_documentation_provided(_Person, _BeforeJudgment) :- fail.
eviction_reason_domestic_abuse(_Lessor, _Tenant) :- fail.
exception_additional_violent_disturbances_threat(_Building) :- fail.

%  9:3261.1(D)(1)(b) prohibition (simplified):
% Unlawful to issue eviction notice based on domestic abuse, when the statute applies,
% the tenant is a documented domestic abuse victim, and no exception applies.
statute_9_3261_1_unlawful_eviction_notice_due_to_domestic_abuse(Lessor, Tenant, Dwelling) :-
    lessor_of(Lessor, Dwelling),
    tenant_of(Tenant, Dwelling),
    dwelling_in_building(Dwelling, Building),
    statute_9_3261_1_applies_to_building(Building),
    eviction_reason_domestic_abuse(Lessor, Tenant),
    domestic_abuse_victim(Tenant),
    reasonable_documentation_provided(Tenant, before_judgment),
    \+ exception_additional_violent_disturbances_threat(Building).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Reasoning: apply statutes to the scenario
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

% Scenario-specific action classification.
scenario_action(eviction_notice) :-
    scenario_statement,
    eviction_notice_issued(_, _, _).

scenario_eviction_basis(Basis) :-
    scenario_statement,
    eviction_notice_issued(_, _, because_of(Basis)).

% Unlawful under  51:2606 if eviction notice is because of a protected basis.
unlawful_under_51_2606 :-
    scenario_action(Action),
    scenario_eviction_basis(Basis),
    statute_51_2606_unlawful_make_unavailable(Action, Basis).

% Unlawful under  9:3261.1 (not triggered by this scenario, but encoded).
unlawful_under_9_3261_1 :-
    scenario_statement,
    eviction_notice_issued(Lessor, Tenant, _),
    tenant_of(Tenant, Dwelling),
    statute_9_3261_1_unlawful_eviction_notice_due_to_domestic_abuse(Lessor, Tenant, Dwelling).

% Overall unlawfulness if any encoded statute prohibits it on these facts.
unlawful_eviction_in_scenario :-
    ( unlawful_under_51_2606
    ; unlawful_under_9_3261_1
    ).

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Answer predicate (deterministic yes/no)
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    unlawful_eviction_in_scenario,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    \+ unlawful_eviction_in_scenario,
    !.

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it unlawful to evict a tenant because of their gender identity?
